paper.purpose: Light page ground; dark instrument-panel ground in dark scheme and on the hero, stage and footer surfaces (Prussian on the footer).

ink.purpose: Headings and body text on light; ivory text on dark.

rule.purpose: Decorative section rules and plate borders at rest. Decorative only.

signal.purpose: Proof, authority, selection and route: primary CTA fill, proof marker, selected tint, route traces on dark. Never text on ivory.

select.purpose: Selected part outline and focus ring.

human.purpose: Approval strokes and fills. Only where a person decides.

human-text.purpose: Decision text on light (4.97:1 on ivory). Brand Allow is 3.65:1 on ivory, so text uses this step.

deny-text.purpose: Refused-by-policy text in the permission demo.

display.use: H1, H2, eyebrows, stage caption, transition line

mono.use: code, commands, evidence, part numbers, diagram labels

slab.use: editorial accent: dialogue request, pull line, closing line (sparingly)

motion.principle: No CSS transitions. Exploded view is a pure function of scroll. Reduced motion shows the final keyframe.

darkMode.strategy: prefers-color-scheme plus [data-theme]; dark scopes .theme-dark (hero, stage) and .theme-prussian (footer) apply in both schemes
darkMode.instrumentPanel: Near Black field, Prussian structure, ivory type, gold proof, gray-blue linework

button-primary.use: Hero and start CTA, once per view

proof-marker.use: Replaces the lightning glyph in copy; aria-hidden

narrative.overview: An authority manual for AI work: a dark cinematic hero, one exploded assembly drawing of a real capture as the signature, and ivory editorial sections. Evidence-disciplined: every proof is a real capture or a labelled drawing.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory and near-black grounds; Prussian identity; contrast carries hierarchy.
Gold marks proof, selection and the one primary action; never text on ivory.
Allow green only where a person decides.
Flat surfaces and hairlines. No gradients, glow, particles or decorative shadows.
Josefin Sans display, IBM Plex Sans text, IBM Plex Mono evidence, Josefin Slab sparingly.
rules: The Gold Is Proof Rule: gold is never body text on ivory and never a large wash.
The Person Decides Rule: Allow appears only at a human decision.
The Measure Rule: running text stops at 68ch.
The Mono Is For Identifiers Rule: Plex Mono sets identifiers, code and status, not sentences.
The Flat Paper Rule: depth is a tonal step or a hairline; the sheet lift is the only shadow.
The Hairline Rule: structure is drawn with 1px lines; selection is a 2px outline, not a glow.
dos: Use gold for proof, selection, route and the one primary action.
Keep the connector notch and the dashed notation of the drawing.
Caption every capture as real or as an illustration.
Collapse every animation under reduced motion.
donts: No gradients, glow, neon, particle fields or decorative glass.
No green headings or decorative green.
No glyph icons or emoji as signifiers.
No drop shadows on cards or buttons.
No 'effortless', 'magic', 'autonomous' as a selling point, and no 'done' without evidence.
